name: Deore XT XC SPD pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 342 g for the left/right PD-M8100 SPD pedal pair, from the explicit /pair weight row in the 2025–2026 specification handbook. This is the standard PD-M8100 model, distinct from the separately identified PD-M8100-UG edition. The handbook notes a supplied 1.0 mm cleat spacer; the weight row does not enumerate cleats or loose accessories.
